text:
karina: Quick security advisory — we found an overly-permissive role (infra_admins) that was granted to a few cross-team groups during last year's infra migration. No active indicators of compromise, but this is high-risk so we need immediate remediation.

sam: Ack. What should teams do now? Timeline?

karina: Timeline: owners must confirm changes within 24h. We'll enforce restrictions (remove infra_admins from non-core groups) in 48h if not addressed. Steps below — short, concrete actions for owners and service-account owners.

karina: 1) Run the RBAC scan tool to list principals with infra_admins:
```bash
./tools/rbac-scan --role infra_admins --org redwood --output json
``` 
Post the output to #eng-security if you see unexpected teams (redact any user emails).

karina: 2) For any human accounts: remove the role from your personal/group membership and use scoped roles or temporary assume-role sessions. For service accounts: rotate keys to short-lived tokens and rebind to least-privilege role.

priya: For service accounts — any preferred rotation command? We still have a handful with static access keys.

lukas: Use this helper for rotation and verification (this will create a short-lived key + update infra secrets):
```bash
./scripts/rotate_sa_key --sa SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAME --update-secret-manager
./scripts/verify_role_binding --sa SERVICE_ACCOUNT_NAME --expected-role limited_infra
``` 
If the script errors, ping eng-infra immediately.

mei: If someone needs an exception window (migration in progress), DM me and karina. We'll log and approve with a compensating control.

sec-bot: Automated scan results: 3 service accounts with keys >90 days, 2 groups outside core infra with infra_admins binding. See detailed report in Google Drive: https://go/reports/priv-role-1791234567

audit-bot: Note: we will run enforcement job at 1791245767 (48h from now) to remove infra_admins from groups that haven't confirmed. All removals are reversible by support ticket within 24h.

sam: Thanks — I'll start running the scan for my team and loop in product infra owners.

karina: Thanks everyone. Reply here when you've completed the scan and any follow-ups. If you hit blockers, escalate to eng-infra and mention @karina @mei. :shield:
